info.title: Haulcast API
info.description: Weather-aware truck routing: route options, weather checkpoints and risk.

get.description: Report liveness, the semantic version and the short git SHA of this build.

get.summary: Readiness probe (SELECT 1 through the runtime database role)
get.description: Report readiness: 200 when the database answers, a 503 problem when it does not.
Return up to ``limit`` places matching ``q`` (2 to 120 characters once normalised).

get.summary: The risk rules (thresholds and load rules) the application applies
Demo weather scenarios (Simulated weather, not a forecast)
get.description: List the scenarios a plan may name in ``scenario``; real forecasts stay the default.

post.summary: Compute a plan: up to three routes with weather risk at every checkpoint
post.description: Create a plan (201, ``Location``) or return the identical recent one (200).

get.summary: A stored plan (7 days), with a strong ETag
get.description: Return the stored plan, or 404 when it is unknown or expired.

get.summary: The 49-frame corridor forecast field of a plan, computed on first request
get.description: Return the plan's heatmap, computing and storing it on the first request.

get.summary: Scheduled maintenance run: delete expired rows, keep the database active
get.description: The cron entry point: Vercel Cron can only issue ``GET``.

post.summary: Manual maintenance run (same cleanup as the scheduled one)
post.description: The same cleanup, triggered by hand with ``POST``.

FieldErrorSchema.description: One invalid field of a validation problem.
FieldErrorSchema.title: FieldErrorSchema

ProblemCode.description:
The stable machine-readable ``code`` of every problem the API answers with.

The members are the wire values: clients branch on them, and the OpenAPI document publishes the
members as the enum of ``ProblemSchema.code`` (D-24), so a new problem starts here and a typo
in a code is a type error instead of a ``KeyError`` on the day it is raised.
ProblemCode.title: ProblemCode

ProblemSchema.description: ``application/problem+json`` body of every error response (RFC 9457 plus our extensions).
ProblemSchema.title: ProblemSchema

GeocodeResponse.description: Body of ``GET /api/v1/geocode``: the normalised query and its candidates, best first.
GeocodeResponse.title: GeocodeResponse

GeocodeResult.description: One candidate place. Every text field is plain data for the UI to render as text.
GeocodeResult.title: GeocodeResult

ScenarioSummarySchema.description: What a scenario picker needs: the id to send back and the words to show.
ScenarioSummarySchema.title: ScenarioSummarySchema

CheckpointDoc.description: A sampled point of a route with its weather, risk and the polyline stretch it paints.
CheckpointDoc.title: CheckpointDoc

DecidedBy.description: The ranking key on which the recommended route beat the runner-up (D-08, D-31).
DecidedBy.title: DecidedBy

Factor.description: A weather factor that is classified on its own scale (DOMAIN-CONTRACT section 3).
Factor.title: Factor

GeometryDoc.description: The route as a GeoJSON ``LineString`` (``[lon, lat]``, simplified for display).
GeometryDoc.title: GeometryDoc

MilesByLevelDoc.description: Miles at each risk level; all five keys are always present.
MilesByLevelDoc.title: MilesByLevelDoc

PlanDoc.description: ``POST /plans`` and ``GET /plans/{plan_id}``: a plan with up to three ranked routes.
PlanDoc.title: PlanDoc

RecommendationDoc.description: Which route to take and why.
RecommendationDoc.title: RecommendationDoc

RequestDoc.description: The normalized request echo (coordinates to 4 decimals, departure to the minute).
RequestDoc.title: RequestDoc

RiskDoc.description: The risk assessment of a checkpoint; ``level`` is ``None`` when the weather is unknown.
RiskDoc.title: RiskDoc

RouteStatus.description: ``OK`` when the recommended route crosses no No Travel miles, else ``NO_SAFE_ROUTE``.
RouteStatus.title: RouteStatus

SourcesDoc.description: Where each input came from; ``attribution`` must be shown to the user.
SourcesDoc.title: SourcesDoc

StatsDoc.description: Mile-weighted risk statistics of a route.
StatsDoc.title: StatsDoc

WeatherDoc.description: The forecast read at a checkpoint's ETA; ``None`` marks a missing value.
WeatherDoc.title: WeatherDoc

PlaceSchema.description: An origin or destination as the client sends it.
PlaceSchema.title: PlaceSchema

PlanRequestSchema.description: Body of ``POST /plans``; unknown fields are rejected.
PlanRequestSchema.title: PlanRequestSchema

FieldsDoc.description: Frame-major arrays; ``risk`` is 0 to 4 or -1 (unknown), the rest ``None`` if unknown.
FieldsDoc.title: FieldsDoc

GridDoc.description: The heatmap grid (D-22): ``lat0`` / ``lon0`` is the south-west corner of cell (0, 0).
GridDoc.title: GridDoc

HeatmapDoc.description: ``GET /plans/{plan_id}/heatmap``: forecast fields over the corridor, 49 hourly frames.
HeatmapDoc.title: HeatmapDoc
